publish.event_name: Pensacola Pickles and Wings Family Festival
publish.card_hook: Wings, pickles, food trucks, contests and live music fill downtown Pensacola's Seville Square for this free festival.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: pensacolafest.com states Saturday, May 15, 2027, 10 AM to 7 PM, free entry, Seville Square, Fountain Park and Bartram Park, downtown Pensacola.

publish.card_hook: Blue crab, live music, vendors and food line the St. Johns riverfront in downtown Palatka for this all ages festival.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: palatkabluecrab.com and the River & Claw Community Foundation's Eventbrite page state Friday May 28 to Sunday May 30, 2027, 9 AM to 11 PM, Riverfront Park / Memorial Parkway, downtown Palatka; all ages, free parking.

publish.card_hook: Food trucks, artisans and local vendors gather in Ulmer Park for a themed evening market in downtown Largo.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: City of Largo special events listing (sourced from The Largo Evening Market) states Sat Sep 26, 2026, 5 to 9 PM, Scavenger Hunt Market, Ulmer Park, 301 West Bay Drive.
